items.headline: U.S. Stocks Rally to All-Time Highs, Driven by Tech and Easing Inflation Concerns
items.summary: U.S. equity markets climbed on Tuesday, with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite reaching new record highs. A decline in oil prices and reduced inflation worries contributed to broad-based gains, particularly in the technology sector. Pre-market futures had indicated a positive open, extending Monday's momentum.

items.headline: Option Care Health surges on buyout discussions
items.summary: Option Care Health ($OPCH) skyrocketed after reports of advanced buyout talks involving McKesson and a private equity firm.

items.headline: Constellation Energy boosted by Google power deal
items.summary: Constellation Energy ($CEG) surged following an announcement of a 20-year power purchase agreement with Google.

items.headline: Marvell Technology jumps on bullish AI forecasts
items.summary: Marvell Technology ($MRVL) gained after significantly raising long-term revenue targets and offering bullish forecasts for AI infrastructure.

items.headline: Seagate Technology tumbles on Toshiba concerns
items.summary: Seagate Technology Holdings ($STX) tumbled amid ongoing concerns about a potential expansion of Toshiba's hard-disk drive capacity.

items.headline: Western Digital slips amid market competition worries
items.summary: Western Digital ($WDC) slipped, also affected by concerns over increased competition in the hard-disk drive market.

items.headline: Moderna falls due to profit-taking
items.summary: Moderna ($MRNA) fell, attributed to profit-taking after the stock had recently hit a fresh 52-week high.

items.headline: Utilities and Industrials Lead, Healthcare and Communication Services Lag
items.summary: Utilities (+2.50%) and Industrials (+1.16%) were among today's leading sectors. Conversely, Healthcare (-0.13%) and Communication Services (-0.14%) experienced slight declines, making them among the day's lagging sectors.

items.headline: Services PMI Meets Expectations, Trade Deficit Narrows
items.summary: The Institute of Supply Management reported the services purchasing managers index at 54.9%, aligning with the Zacks Consensus Estimate. Additionally, the U.S. trade deficit plummeted to -$105.6 billion in August.

items.headline: Oil Prices Ease, Treasury Yields Retreat
items.summary: Brent crude oil prices dropped 2% to $98.30 per barrel, easing inflation concerns. The 10-year Treasury yield also retreated, falling to 5.25% from 5.31% recorded late Monday.

items.headline: Constellation Brands Reports Q2 Earnings Post-Market Close
items.summary: Constellation Brands ($STZ) is set to release its second-quarter earnings report after the market closes today. Investors anticipate further insights into the company's performance. Lamb Weston's (LW) profit and revenue topped projections, leading to a 10.8% rally in its stock today.

items.headline: AI Enthusiasm Continues to Drive Market Momentum
items.summary: The ongoing AI spending boom continues to be a significant driver for market performance, with expectations of nearly 30% Q3 earnings growth for the S&P 500, especially from companies with strong AI ties.
